# Signwell

SignWell is an electronic signature tool for legally binding e-signatures and faster document signing.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/signwell/.

## Actions

- **Create Document**: Create and optionally send a new document for signing.
- **Create Webhook**: Register a webhook callback url.
- **Delete Document**: Delete a document (and cancel signing if in progress).
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a registered webhook.
- **Get Credentials**: Retrieve account information for the current api key.
- **Get Document**: Return a document and all associated document data.
- **List Bulk Sends**: List all bulk sends.
- **List Webhooks**: List all registered webhooks.
